title: Pineapple Angel Food Cake
description: This pineapple angel food cake is a quick and easy dessert to make with just 3 prepared ingredients: cake mix, canned pineapple, and whipped topping.
ingredients: 1 (20 ounce) can crushed pineapple with juice
1 (16 ounce) package angel food cake mix
1 (12 ounce) container frozen whipped topping, thawed

steps.text: Gather the ingredients. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C). Spray a 9x13-inch pan with cooking spray.
Mix pineapple with juice and cake mix together in a large bowl until well combined; pour batter into the prepared pan.
Bake in the preheated oven until golden brown, about 25 minutes. Let cake cool; serve with whipped topping.

video.description: In this video, you’ll see how to make a super-easy pineapple angel food cake. All you need are three ingredients! Easy enough to make any time, sensational enough to impress company—it's the best of both worlds. And for a tropical twist, add flaked coconut and a little rum extract.
